response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior engineer with deep open-source involvement, Linux experience, and a broad technical range across web, embedded, and high-performance systems. However, this is an executive-level leadership role requiring C1 German (he lists only basic German), and his resume shows no formal team leadership, people management, or client advisory experience — the core of the role. The technical foundation is solid, but the leadership and language gaps are disqualifying for this particular position.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience across diverse stacks, with strong Linux and open-source credentials (founder of open-source GISCollective, FOSS4G speaker)
Demonstrated knowledge-sharing through workshops, courses, and conference talks
Solid software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, architecture of distributed and low-latency systems)
concerns: German proficiency is 'Basic' — role explicitly requires minimum C1
No demonstrated formal leadership, team management, or executive-level client advisory experience
No evidence of UML modeling, requirements management, or IT security/compliance expertise required by the role

key_factors.factor: German language gap (Basic vs. required C1)
Strong open-source and Linux technical background
